extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Qompass AI's SFW game maker: an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28) holding authoring and project state for SFW games — scaffolding, cast and canon, systems and narrative authoring, asset routing, playtest, and release handoff — with a live lane gate that refuses NSFW and unclassified input before any authoring. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Meister does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Meister

skills.description: Create and inspect Qompass game projects with estate conventions in place and the project's genre pipeline pack selected at birth.
skills.name: Project scaffolding

skills.description: Character identity records, identity locks at intake (silhouette, palette, proportions, thumbnail recognisability), and canon census checks.
skills.name: Cast and canon

skills.description: Scene graphs, schedules, flags, progression DAGs, economies, state machines, and minigame definitions as validated, bounded records.
skills.name: Scenes and systems authoring

skills.description: Dialogue as structured game data with whole-body reaction profiles, branching, and continuity effects.
skills.name: Dialogue and narrative creation

skills.description: Story arcs, beats, quests, character arcs, branching endings, level composition, and deterministic playtest generation from the authored graph.
skills.name: Story, plot, and level making

skills.description: Rating metadata (ESRB, PEGI, IARC), age-appropriateness review records, photosafety and accessibility checks, and plain-language content summaries.
skills.name: Content standards and accessibility

skills.description: Intake, hash, provenance, and keeper-chain records for media artifacts, with handoffs to lumen, eigenstyle, bloch, and fathom.
skills.name: Asset routing and provenance

skills.description: Scripted playthrough definitions, deterministic replay and hash checks, screenshot specifications, and defect records tied to project state.
skills.name: Playtest and QA

skills.description: The SFW channel-target registry (Play, F-Droid, itch.io, Steam, GOG, Epic, Humble, App Store, Microsoft Store, console portals, direct web), release preparation, and publish preflight.
skills.name: Build and release handoff

skills.description: Channel account records holding credential references and status — never values — with verification probes, expiry, and rotation tracking.
skills.name: Channel credentials and sessions
